summary: Both full halves inspected. Visibly is handwritten above its cancelled typed former position,and requires a word space after but. The two cancelled positions after name remain unreadable. The following cancelled can be and later some are readable. The parenthetical every-sheaf explanation and can be occupy a typed interlinear line. Global is also typed above the line. The r in aspheric is typed over t. Several h forms have displaced typed repetitions;the first The and later This contain older crowded marks under T. Subobjects has s over a,and the has t over a. The n in In is pen-retouched over n;the c starting the continuation of verticality is pen over an unreadable old impression. The crowded cancelled impression below an A-hat is retained as an unreadable layer. The marginal less-than-shaped pencil sign and archive34 are preserved. Source spellings,joined toothat,and the sentence about the empty case are not normalized.

The h has displaced repeated typed stem/serif traces above and below the live impression.
The old s/o/m/e contours remain legible under their x strikes.

The h has repeated typed impressions displaced vertically.

The c at the continuation of verticality is retouched in pen over an older obscured type impression.

The live caret stands above a vertically crowded cancelled impression. Preserve that unreadable lower layer. The caret itself remains uncolored because neither this inspection nor an independent second reading securely distinguishes pen from a dark repeated typed caret.
The line break divides the source contraction. Join it without introducing a space or changing the apostrophe.

The upper corrected caret has an uneven filled apex,but a dark repeated typed caret cannot be excluded. The lower-right caret is cleaner and near-symmetric. Independent review agrees that darkness alone does not establish pen provenance.
